title: Terms follow brain's reflection too
quote: The reflection that maintains brain and resolves contradictions is part of brain itself, so it should govern terms the same way: superseding and merging them.
means: The reflection is brain's: it governs decisions and terms alike. A new term can supersede or merge earlier terms; the current glossary is computed.

supersedes.what: d-cbd4 gave the reflection to decisions; it is brain's, for decisions and terms alike.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-8725 that held
